subject: Kickoff: ClearBeacon vendor profile & PO routing
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@clearbeacon.io>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Cc: carlos@clearbeacon.io
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor setup — ClearBeacon legal + payment info

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking this — nice to meet you. We're ready to get set up in Redwood's vendor system so you can start routing POs for the quarterly freight engagement. Attached are our initial forms: W-9 and a completed onboarding worksheet. A few quick clarifications up front: our legal name is "ClearBeacon Logistics, LLC" (EIN 12-3456789), and our remit address is the billing office in Phoenix (see form).

Questions:
- Do you need a separate remit email for EDI vs. PDF invoices?
- Is there a preferred PO contact (name/email) you want listed on invoices to guarantee automated matching?
- Do you require a Certificate of Insurance for amounts above $250k? We can attach one but want to confirm the limits required.

We'll also attach the vendor portal invite if that helps — sending COI once I confirm the required limits.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Vendor Operations Manager
ClearBeacon Logistics
attachments: [ClearBeacon_W9.pdf (application/pdf), vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: jasmine.liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@clearbeacon.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup — ClearBeacon legal + payment info

Hi Elena — great to meet you and thanks for the attachments. I kicked off the vendor intake; a few items and next steps below.

Checklist (what I need to complete your vendor master):
1) Confirm legal name and EIN (you provided: ClearBeacon Logistics, LLC / 12-3456789) — OK, I have that on the worksheet.
2) Remit address for payments (street + city + postal code) — your worksheet shows 2801 E Camelback Rd, Phoenix, AZ 85016; please confirm.
3) Preferred invoice email and PO matching field — does finance prefer invoices to include "PO Number" in subject line or the reference field? For automated processing we recommend PO in the header and invoices to be emailed to ap-invoices@clearbeacon.io or sent via EDI.
4) Banking for ACH — we'll need a voided check or bank letter if you want ACH enabled; otherwise we'll set ACH disabled and use manual wires until verification completes.
5) Certificate of Insurance — Redwood requires COI for freight partners at $1M general liability and $2M auto. If you can upload that we can attach to your vendor profile.

Jonas (AP) — can you confirm Redwood's preferred invoice format and if we should enable EDI for this vendor?

Marissa — heads-up this could be a recurring spend partner; want to loop you on contract review once vendor is in the system.

Elena, I attached a short onboarding worksheet and a link to our vendor portal. If you fill the worksheet and upload the COI + banking docs, I can complete the master record and enable PO routing. I can also provision a separate remit contact for invoice delivery if you want a dedicated inbox.

Next steps:
- Elena: confirm remit address, upload COI and banking doc to portal (link below) — target by Fri 09/25 if possible.
- Jasmine: set up vendor record & provisional PO routing once docs are uploaded.
- Jonas: confirm EDI preference and whether we can enable automatic 3-way match for freight invoices.

Portal link: https://redwood-inference.vendor-portal.example/portal/clearbeacon

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Procurement Partner
Redwood Inference
signature: Jasmine Liu | Senior Procurement Partner | Redwood Inference

From: Carlos Mejia <carlos@clearbeacon.io>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Cc: elena@clearbeacon.io
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup — ClearBeacon legal + payment info

Hi Jasmine — thanks for the detailed checklist. Quick answers below and a couple of clarifications:

- Remit address confirmed: 2801 E Camelback Rd, Phoenix, AZ 85016.
- Invoices: we'll have ap-invoices@clearbeacon.io as the primary invoice inbox. We'll also expose an EDI endpoint if Redwood enables EDI — please advise point of contact for EDI onboarding.
- ACH: we'll upload a bank letter for verification to enable ACH. If you prefer the voided check, we can provide that as well.
- COI: attaching the certificate at the requested limits.

Attachments: [COI_ClearBeacon.pdf (application/pdf)]

Two quick asks:
1) Can Redwood include our VAT-like registration field for international reconciliation even if we are US-only now? We anticipate EU lanes later.
2) When you create the vendor record, can you set the default PO expiration to 90 days and enable "receive confirmation" flag so our dispatch can confirm POs quickly?

If helpful we can schedule a 15-minute EDI/PO format sync next week.

Best,
Carlos Mejia
Finance Ops Lead
ClearBeacon Logistics

From: jasmine.liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mejia <carlos@clearbeacon.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup — ClearBeacon legal + payment info

Carlos — perfect, thanks. I uploaded the COI to the intake and have the remit address confirmed. A few responses to your asks: 

- VAT field: yes, our vendor schema includes an optional tax_id_vat field; I can add a placeholder so you can populate it later. No impact if blank today.
- Default PO expiration: we can set PO expiry to 90 days for this supplier and enable the "acknowledge receipt" flag. I'll toggle those in the vendor profile.
- EDI: Jonas, can you own the EDI onboarding? If so, please share the EDI spec and a preferred test mailbox.

Jonas: Redwood AP prefers invoices with PO in the invoice header. For EDI we generally use an ANSI X12 810; if ClearBeacon wants to start with emailed PDFs we can enable automatic 3-way match on our side once banking is verified.

Marissa: once the profile is created I will route the standard procurement contract for your review (it will reference carriage SLAs and indemnity limits matching the COI).

Elena/Carlos: I have enough to create the vendor record now (legal name, EIN, remit address, COI attached). Please upload the bank verification doc and confirm the invoice email. I will mark the vendor as "provisionally active — PO routing enabled" so you can receive POs while ACH verification completes. Expect a confirmation email with the vendor ID later today.

Cheers,
Jasmine
Senior Procurement Partner
Redwood Inference
attachments: [vendor_profile_preview.pdf (application/pdf)]
